messages:
marie: quick hit — ran a 12h perf sweep of kernel-selector v2 on prod-sim. p95 stable (~120ms) but p99 spikes to ~1.2s when kv_miss_rate > 18% and microbatch_size >= 8. suspect kernel fallback + synchronous refill stalls.

aj: can you paste the perf summary / config you used?

marie: sure, here's the run header:
```
run_id: prod-sim-kselector-v2-2026-03-17
microbatch_size: 8
prefetch: disabled
kv_policy: on-demand
kernel_selector: v2 (heuristic: seq_len, model_arch)
observed: p95=120ms, p99=1.2s, mean=140ms
kv_miss_rate: 22%
gpu_util_avg: 0.92
fallback_count: kernel_flip=1127
notes: tail correlated with fallback events and memcpy stalls
```

suresh: that fallback_count is big — when v2 flips from fused->generic the path does a sync memcpy to CPU in a few codepaths. we saw similar on the 11/2025 perf run. can you grab a kernel-selection trace?

marie: pasted a tiny excerpt from the selector log around a spike:
```
[12:04:05.123] selector: batch_id=534 kernel=aten_fused_v2 chosen
[12:04:05.126] kv: miss batch_id=534 prefetch=false
[12:04:05.127] runtime: kernel_fallback -> generic_matmul (memcopy sync)
[12:04:05.327] batch_ready -> complete
```

nina: oof — that 200ms memcpy explains a lot. If microbatch holds 8 sequences that stall entire batch. two quick ideas: async prefetch + smaller microbatch cap for high-kv-miss flows.

aj: propose admission policy tweak to test tomorrow A/B:
```
admission:
  target_utilization: 0.75
  max_microbatch_size: 6
  kv_prefetch: async
  fallback_soft_timeout_ms: 40
```

marie: i can run A=mb=6 vs B=mb=8 with async prefetch on A and current on B. will instrument memcpy latency and fallback_count.

perf-bot: <alert> canary window (kselector-v2) shows p99 +110% vs baseline in last 30m</alert>

suresh: also adding a metric: `kernel_fallback_sync_ms` and `kv_prefetch_latency_ms` to the per-request trace will help attribute. if fallback_sync_ms > 50ms we consider immediate shed.

nina: operationally i'd lower the target_util to 0.80 for the cluster and let admission shed aggressively when kv_miss_rate trending up. microbatch auto-shrink rule: if kv_miss_rate > 10% reduce microbatch by 25% with cooldown 60s.

marie: noted. i'll schedule two ~1h loadtests and a 3h canary tomorrow morning 02:00-06:00 UTC. plan: run A (admission target 0.75, max_mb 6, async prefetch) vs B (current settings). collecting p50/p95/p99, fallback_sync_ms histogram, memcpy tail.

aj: sg. can you drop the config in experiments repo and tag me? i'll wire the dashboard for the canary.

marie: will do. cc @aj @suresh @nina. thanks — will follow up with results + traces. :eyes:
